system.description:
You can fill your opponent with doubt by making a Persuasion check as a Standard Action against a single target that can hear and understand you within 12 squares of you. If your check result equals or exceeds the target's Will Defense, the target takes a -2 penalty to its base speed, and if the target takes a Standard Action, it must also spend its Swift Action.

This penalty lasts until the end of the target's next turn.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
